name: Fungal infection
description: A medical condition presenting with itching and other symptoms.

name: Diabetes
description: A metabolic disease causing high blood sugar levels, increasingly common in Nigeria.
symptoms: Fatigue, Weight Loss, Restlessness, Lethargy, Irregular Blood Sugar, Blurred Vision, Excessive Hunger, Increased Appetite, Excessive Urination

name: Gastroenteritis
description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, commonly called stomach flu.

name: Bronchial Asthma
description: A chronic condition causing airway inflammation and breathing difficulty.
symptoms: Fatigue, Cough, High Fever, Shortness of Breath, Mucus in Cough

name: Hypertension
description: High blood pressure, a leading cause of stroke and heart disease in Nigeria.
symptoms: Headache, Chest Pain, Dizziness, Loss of Balance, Difficulty Concentrating

name: Migraine
description: A neurological condition causing severe recurring headaches.
symptoms: Acidity, Indigestion, Headache, Blurred Vision, Excessive Hunger, Stiff Neck, Depression, Irritability

name: Jaundice
description: A condition causing yellowing of skin and eyes, often a sign of liver problems.
symptoms: Itching, Vomiting, Fatigue, Weight Loss, High Fever, Yellowing of Skin, Dark Urine, Abdominal Pain

name: Malaria
description: A mosquito-borne infectious disease common in Nigeria, caused by Plasmodium parasites.
symptoms: Chills, Vomiting, High Fever, Sweating, Headache, Nausea, Diarrhea, Muscle Pain

name: Chicken pox
description: A medical condition presenting with itching and other symptoms.
symptoms: Itching, Skin Rash, Fatigue, Lethargy, High Fever, Headache, Loss of Appetite, Mild Fever, Swollen Lymph Nodes, General Malaise, Red Spots on Body

name: Dengue
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing severe flu-like illness.
symptoms: Skin Rash, Chills, Joint Pain, Vomiting, Fatigue, Headache, Nausea, Loss of Appetite, Pain Behind Eyes, Back Pain, General Malaise, Muscle Pain, Red Spots on Body

name: Typhoid
description: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella typhi, spread through contaminated food and water.
symptoms: Chills, Vomiting, Fatigue, High Fever, Headache, Nausea, Constipation, Abdominal Pain, Diarrhea, Belly Pain

name: Hepatitis A
description: A viral liver infection spread through contaminated food and water.
symptoms: Joint Pain, Vomiting, Yellowing of Skin, Dark Urine, Nausea, Loss of Appetite, Abdominal Pain, Diarrhea, Mild Fever, Yellowing of Eyes, Muscle Pain

name: Hepatitis B
description: A serious viral liver infection, endemic in Nigeria with high prevalence.
symptoms: Itching, Fatigue, Lethargy, Yellowing of Skin, Dark Urine, Loss of Appetite, Abdominal Pain, Yellow Urine, Yellowing of Eyes, General Malaise

name: Tuberculosis
description: A serious bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs, spread through the air.
symptoms: Chills, Vomiting, Fatigue, Weight Loss, Cough, High Fever, Shortness of Breath, Sweating, Loss of Appetite, Mild Fever, Yellowing of Eyes, Swollen Lymph Nodes, General Malaise, Phlegm, Chest Pain, Blood in Cough

name: Common Cold
description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract, usually mild and self-limiting.
symptoms: Sneezing, Chills, Fatigue, Cough, High Fever, Headache, Swollen Lymph Nodes, General Malaise, Phlegm, Sore Throat, Red Eyes, Sinus Pressure, Runny Nose, Nasal Congestion, Chest Pain, Loss of Smell, Muscle Pain

name: Pneumonia
description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in the lungs, very common in Nigeria.
symptoms: Chills, Fatigue, Cough, High Fever, Shortness of Breath, Sweating, General Malaise, Phlegm, Chest Pain, Rapid Heartbeat, Rusty Coloured Sputum

name: Heart attack
description: A medical condition presenting with vomiting and other symptoms.
symptoms: Vomiting, Shortness of Breath, Sweating, Chest Pain

name: Arthritis
description: Inflammation of joints causing pain and stiffness.
symptoms: Muscle Weakness, Stiff Neck, Swelling Joints

name: Urinary tract infection
description: A medical condition presenting with burning urination and other symptoms.
symptoms: Burning Urination, Bladder Discomfort, Foul-smelling Urine, Frequent Urination
